description: A luminous spectral woman floats within an ancient crumbling temple overgrown by bioluminescent vines and swirling cosmic mist, her translucent form merging with floating runes and shattered mirrors that reflect impossible galaxies, while golden koi swim through veins of liquid starlight that drip from levitating marble columns, all bathed in soft moonlight filtering through a fractured celestial dome where time itself appears to dissolve.
